summary: One sprint since the writing preferences release (milestone 74). Home stays usable with many applications: above six, a toolbar searches application names (every word, ignoring case and accents), filters by status with a count on each chip, and sorts by last activity, name, date created or status (#2277, #2278). A List view shows one row per application with Open and a menu for Archive, Restore and Delete; archived applications follow the same search and view (#2278). View and sort are remembered on each device, never on the server (#2279). Screen change only: no API, storage or model change.
knownLimitations: Applications cannot be grouped yet; one-level folders follow in milestone 77 (#2280-#2283). Cards keep their Archive and Delete buttons until the folders milestone adds Move to their menu. Search matches application names only, not job text.
